hypothesis.title: Valuation and Subsequent Returns in Vietnam: Does a Low Market P/E Predict Higher One-Year VN-Index Returns?
hypothesis.statement: A low VN-Index trailing P/E predicts a higher VN-Index return over the next 252 sessions.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The slope of the 252-session-ahead VN-Index log return on the P/E is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The slope is negative (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Overlapping-horizon predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: slope of 252d forward return on P/E
